description: Operator-Assisted Physical Knob Stepping with Spacebar Confirmation

routingGuide.stimulusOutput: DAC Out 1 (Eurorack Level / -10dBV) -> Module Audio IN
routingGuide.responseInput: Module Audio OUT -> ADC In 1 (with Eurorack Attenuator)
routingGuide.notes: Use 3.5mm mono mini-jack patch cables. Ensure ADC is protected from 10Vpp modular levels.
steps: Patch Audio Interface Out 1 to Eurorack Module Audio IN using a 3.5mm TS patch cable.
Patch Eurorack Module Audio OUT through an attenuator/line-level converter to Interface In 1.
Verify Eurorack case power rails (+12V/-12V/5V) are energized.
Set Cutoff Frequency potentiometer to 12 o'clock (nominal center).

preSessionSetup.description: Set Cutoff Frequency pot to 12 o'clock (50%)
Set Resonance pot to fully closed 0%
